key.name: pos-x
key.description: Horizontal position of the widget on the desktop, in pixels from the left.

key.name: pos-y
key.description: Vertical position of the widget on the desktop, in pixels from the top.

key.name: opacity
key.description: Background opacity of the widget card, from 0 (transparent) to 100 (solid).

key.name: show-date
key.description: Whether to show the date line under the clock.

key.name: show-stats
key.description: Whether to show live CPU and RAM usage.

key.name: use-24h
key.description: Whether to display time in 24-hour format instead of 12-hour AM/PM.

key.name: refresh-seconds
key.description: How often, in seconds, to refresh CPU/RAM stats.

key.name: accent-color
key.description: Hex color used for the clock text and accent bar.
